hits.why: a cause is testimony before it is anything else. Every stated cause — and above all every claim about WHY an agent did something — is read off the record it came from: that agent's OUTPUT.md, its transcript, `git log`, the command's own output. A cause inferred from this turn's own reasoning is the tunnel, and a rule proposed on one bans whatever it happens to reach
